runtime: class RuntimeStateService { RedisTemplate<String, Object> redisTemplate; RuntimeStateField field; Duration ttl = Duration.ofMinutes(10); void update() { redisTemplate.expire("runtime", ttl); } void clearConversation(String conversationId) { redisTemplate.delete(conversationId); } }
